About Us  


Supio is a trusted AI platform purpose-built for law firms, reshaping how data drives impactful outcomes. Our innovative approach blends technology with deep legal expertise, making us a leader in our field. We go beyond surface-level AI to deeply understand our customers’ daily needs, empowering law firms with unparalleled data insights. Supio delivers human-level, accurate analysis of complex data and legal records, quickly and efficiently bringing critical insights when they matter most. Trusted by top litigation lawyers, our platform has supported over $1 billion in settlements.

Headquartered in Seattle with an office in San Francisco, we raised $60M Series B in April 2025 led by Sapphire Ventures with Mayfield and Thomson Reuters Ventures, bringing total funding to $91M. We're scaling rapidly and looking for exceptional talent to join us in this next phase of growth.

​​We're looking for passionate team members who are motivated by our mission and ready to help us achieve it.


What we're looking for


We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Product Team at Supio in either Seattle or San Francisco. You have a deep understanding of our domain and desire to delight our customers. You will oversee the entire product development lifecycle, from strategy and roadmap creation to execution and launch, eventually managing and mentoring a team of product managers, while also collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to ensure product success. You'll report directly to the Chief Product Officer. 

What you'll do


  • Product Vision and Strategy: You'll define the long-term vision and strategy for a product area, ensuring it aligns with our overall goals.
  • Roadmap Development: You'll create and maintain the product roadmap, prioritizing features and ensuring they are aligned with market needs and business objectives.
  • Market Research and Analysis: You'll conduct market research to understand customer needs, identify opportunities, and validate product ideas.
  • Product Backlog Management:You'll manage the product backlog, ensuring it is prioritized and contains the necessary information for our development teams.
  • Stakeholder Management: You'll work closely with stakeholders, including engineering, marketing, sales, and executives, to ensure everyone is aligned and informed
  • Product Development Process: You'll oversee the product development process, ensuring our products are developed and launched on time and within budget.
  • Launch Planning and post-launch analysis: Plan and execute product launches, ensuring a smooth and successful launch. Analyze product performance after launch, identifying areas for improvement and making data-driven decisions


Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business Administration, or related field; or equivalent experience in software engineering.
  • 10+ years of experience in product management or technical leadership in B2B environments, with a strong preference for experience in AI.
  • Proven ability to use data and analytics to inform decision-making and improve product features.
  • Skilled in managing cross-functional teams and driving projects to successful completion.
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey complex ideas effectively.


Compensation
As an early-stage startup, we offer a competitive compensation package that includes base salary, meaningful equity, and benefits. Equity grants are designed to ensure employees share in the long-term success and upside of the company.

Base Salary: $200,000 - $250,000 annually

Actual compensation may vary outside of these ranges based on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, and geographic location.

Compensation & Benefits
  • 💰 Competitive Salary + Meaningful Equity
  • 💹 401(k)
  • ⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • 🏝 Flexible Time Off + Holidays
  • 🧑‍💻 High-autonomy work environment, every Tuesday is a Remote Work Day
  • 🥗 DoorDash subsidies for breakfast and dinner; Daily lunch options
  • 🧋 Boba Wednesdays
  • 🚃 Monthly commuter subsidies and pre-tax parking contribution
  • 🚀 Team gatherings and offsites

E-Verify Participation Notice  

Supio participates in E-Verify, an employment authorization program through the U.S. Department of Homeland Security and the Social Security Administration. 

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement 

Supio is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
